worlds.title: Four halls
worlds.blurb: Blue to rose. Walk the doors. Unseal the last hall.

worlds.title: The Hollow House
worlds.blurb: Fires, a dining room, a crypt. The attic stays shut until you find the pad.

worlds.title: Circuit Grid
worlds.blurb: A plus hub. Wide cyan, tight red, blue catwalk, a ribbon you can see, a locked gold vault.

worlds.title: The Ages
worlds.blurb: Nine rooms, nine centuries. Court, cave, nave, bay, glass, loft, hull.

worlds.title: Drift
worlds.blurb: One-way. Doors do not come back. It will not remember you.
